statement: Every proper section over Q lifts to the full cuspidally central quotient of an elliptic curve punctured at a union of torsion sub-packets. In particular every profinite rank-one exponent on the conductor243 cubic lifts; its fibre is the product of four completed multiplicative groups specified by the four cusp residue fields.
depends_on: Borne-Emsalem-Stix2015 Theorem5.10, Proposition3.5 and continuous-cohomology Proposition4.2; Shapiro and Kummer; exact flex residue algebra
answers: A.12 and Lead5: full-coefficient infinite-kernel survival in an explicitly identified quotient; refinement of A.44
notes: The quotient is pi1(U)/closure[I,Delta], where I is the kernel of geometric compactification, not intrinsic gamma3 or Delta-double-prime. Its kernel over pi1(E) has rank9, including the central compact commutator, and the fibre is H1(Q,Zhat(1)[D]). It is strictly smaller than the intrinsic class-two and metabelian quotients for nine punctures. The theorem proves abstract continuous global lifts without Selmerness; A.60 supplies explicit exponents for which Selmer lifts cannot exist. No unsupported inverse-limit compatibility or inaccessible published Saidi theorem is used.

statement: For every elliptic curve E/k, full torsion divisor D=E[N], nontorsion R in E(k), and nonempty finite coefficient-prime set P, the proper Kummer class (1-e_P)kappa(R) admits no geometrically abelian Selmer lift to E-D. On the rank-one cubic this excludes all n(1-e_P), n a nonzero integer, including the exponent zero at2 and one at all odd primes.
depends_on: Full local Tate Kummer injectivity; unit characters div(f_d)=N(d-O); prime-to-residue torsion reduction and formal multiplication isometry; finite S-unit power classes; Riemann-Hurwitz; Faltings1983 Satz7 with1984erratum
answers: A.12 and Lead5: uniform mechanism excluding an explicit one-prime and finite-prime ghost family already at abelian Selmer level, for every elliptic twist with full flex divisor
notes: One fixed finite set S comes from the finitely many global mod-lambda unit classes, lambda coprime to N. For R_j=M^j R, the local primary-component argument forces all f_d(R_j) valuations outside S to be divisible by lambda. This gives infinitely many points on finitely many genus-lambda twists, contradicting Faltings. For N3, lambda2, the covers have genus2; all flex tangent functions and 857 cyclic reduction cases were exactly verified. A finite-kernel quotient above full TE already retains the needed toric information, but its abstract lifts of A.44 fail Selmerness. No effective offending-place bound, no identification with a particular congruence cover, and no result for all arbitrary noninteger exponents or infinite removed-prime sets is claimed.
